description:
Onchain Loyalty-as-a-Service on Base L2. AI agents can create loyalty programs, mint ERC-20 tokens, manage rewards, trade on P2P marketplace, and get analytics — all via MCP.

## Features
- 9 tools for autonomous loyalty management
- ERC-20 token minting on Base (chain ID 8453)
- Rewards, tiers, referrals, vouchers
- P2P marketplace for token trading
- Real-time analytics

## Authentication
Get your API key at [loyalspark.online/merchant](https://loyalspark.online/merchant) → AI Agents tab.
